verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports import of cURL and OpenAPI (with tag-as-folder mapping) and simultaneous import of collections/environments, plus collections/folders organization for portability within the tool, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of exporting collections to a standard portable format (e.g., Postman/OpenAPI export) or round-trip compatibility, and a community request notes the lack of git-based/file-based collection sync as a recurring pain point. Missing for 10: explicit export documentation, evidence of exporting to widely-used formats, and confirmation of lossless round-trip import/export between tools.
